## Task / Aufgabe

What are you trying to do, and where is the current limitation?

## Proposed behavior / Gewünschtes Verhalten

Describe the smallest useful change and any example UI/menu path.

## Area / Bereich

Device UI / storage / NFC / Bluetooth / bootloader / web file manager / documentation

## Compatibility / Kompatibilität

Relevant versions, hardware and storage layout if known. Does the idea change
existing files, protocols or update requirements? It is fine to leave unknown
details open rather than infer them.
